subject: Renewal procurement: onboarding refresh + PO sprint
messages:
From: Lara Silva <lara.silva@heliomed.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Berger <tberger@heliomed.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Jul 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal: procurement onboarding refresh and PO window

Hi Aisha / Marissa,

Our renewal for the capacity bundle (HLMD-45321) hits the desk next week and procurement wants to refresh the vendor onboarding artifacts before issuing the PO. Two asks from our side:

1) Can you share an updated onboarding checklist + any SOC2 evidence pointers we should include for our security team?
2) Can we confirm an expected PO delivery window? Legal prefers to have a signed SOW and PO by end of next week, but procurement typically needs 7 business days to process once artifacts are in the portal.

I'm attaching a short list of the documents procurement will request on their side (heliomed-evidence-request.pdf). We also have a preferred PO template; I'll attach that once I get it from the buyer.

If we can get a short mutual action plan (owner + due date) I can fast-track the buyer. Thanks — appreciate the help.

Best,
Lara
Procurement Manager, Heliomed

Attachment: heliomed-evidence-request.pdf
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
To: Lara Silva <lara.silva@heliomed.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Jul 2028 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: procurement onboarding refresh and PO window

Hi Lara — thanks for the heads up.

Proposed plan (quick MAP):
- Today (Aisha): Share onboarding checklist + term proposal (see attachments).
- Thu 7/6 (Marissa): Provide SOC2 attestation excerpt and evidence pointers for your security team.
- Fri 7/7 (Ben): Confirm billing terms and PO cadence (cc'ing Ben).
- Mon 7/10 (Karthik): Prepare a short SOW amendment for the renewed term and capacity bump.
- Wed 7/12: Target for signed PO in portal and DocuSign SOW.

Notes: We can support fast-pathing in the Redwood procurement portal (we'll pre-fill metadata so your buyer only uploads the PO). If procurement needs a vendor portal invite for specific reviewers, let us know names and emails and we'll provision access.

Attachments: redwood-onboard-checklist.xlsx, redwood-term-proposal-v1.pdf

If the 7/12 date is tight for your side, tell me the hard deadline and we'll rework.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this smoothly.

— Aisha
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Lara Silva <lara.silva@heliomed.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Tom Berger <tberger@heliomed.com>
Date: Thu, 6 Jul 2028 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: procurement onboarding refresh and PO window

Thanks Aisha — this MAP helps. A couple of notes from procurement:

- Our buyer prefers Net-60 for standard renewals given internal approval cycles. Will Redwood accept Net-60 on the PO?
- We will attach the PO template from procurement (PO_template_heliomed.docx) so you can confirm fields we need to pre-populate in the portal.

Tom (cc): I'll need procurement legal to verify the SOW change language before we sign.

I'll drop the PO template in a follow up within the hour.

Best,
Lara
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Lara Silva <lara.silva@heliomed.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 7 Jul 2028 10:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: procurement onboarding refresh and PO window

Hi Lara / team — Ben from Finance here. Quick take on payment terms: 

We usually default to Net-30 for renewal upsells; Net-60 stretches our working capital forecast and would require a credit review. For larger commitments we can consider Net-45 as a compromise and flag it to Revenue Ops.

Proposal: Net-45 on the PO for this renewal (HLMD-45321). If that works for Heliomed we'll note it in the billing amendment and provide invoice cadence. I've attached a short billing amendment draft for your review (billing-amendment.docx).

Also, could your procurement lead submit names for portal access so IT can provision reviewer accounts? If you send the buyer email, we'll create the invite and pre-populate the PO metadata to reduce upload friction.

— Ben
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

Attachment: billing-amendment.docx
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Lara Silva <lara.silva@heliomed.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Jul 2028 15:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: procurement onboarding refresh and PO window

Hi Lara — looping on legal.

I've drafted a short SOW amendment that captures the term extension and the 20% capacity uplift you're requesting. It's intentionally small: identical service descriptions, added capacity table, and the billing schedule reflecting Net-45 (per Ben's note). No material security changes.

Please review the redline summary and let us know any material contract asks by EOD Thu 7/11. If we don't see redlines we'll push to DocuSign for signature on 7/12.

Attachment: sow-amendment-diff.txt

Team — good news. Our buyer has approved the Net-45 compromise. Attached is the signed PO (Heliomed_PO_45321.pdf) and we've completed the procurement upload.

Next steps from Heliomed: 
- We completed signature on the PO and have uploaded to your portal.
- DocuSign for the SOW amendment is live (https://app.docusign.com/signer/SIGN-12345). Please review and sign so we can close the renewal.
- We'd like to schedule a 2-week onboarding sprint to start the week of 2028-07-24. Can you confirm availability for a kickoff and the pre-provisioning window?

Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. If Redwood can provision the reviewer accounts today it'll speed acceptance on our end.

Best,
Lara Silva
Procurement Manager, Heliomed
